summary: Runs one coherent Agent turn from fresh Project/Case facts through one selected Case gap, workspace execution, evidence, transition claim, and handoff.
runtime_notes: Default Runtime execution invokes one agent_loop turn per Case gap and reuses one stable Codex thread for the active todo/session.
The Agent may use native tools and other installed skills inside the same turn; Runtime does not pre-bind a fixed definition/diagnosis skill list or predictive allowed_paths.
Runtime supplies original user intent, current increment, fresh bounded canonical facts, revisions, and execution authorization; these supersede conflicting thread history.
No suitable active Case produces case_control.create_case; Runtime only binds Project revision and explicit review policy before calling the trusted ledger entrypoint.
Every Case transition binds the expected Case updated_at, observed Project updated_at, and complete current candidate gap.
Runtime gates schema, revision, authorization, workspace safety, and ledger legality; it does not semantically re-review the Agent claim.
Successful ledger writeback requires a fresh state read before the next turn. Only human or external responsibility pauses automatic continuation.
Serial one-gap Loops, productive rounds, and long-running commands have no total wall-clock or productive-round limit; no-progress recovery is separate.
